This article was amended in notification no. G-2 1008/X—918–1958, dated January 6, 1961. Before amendment this article stood as follows :

351–B. (a) in determining the amount of recovery to be made under article 351-A, the Provincial Government shall take into consideration the extent of loss caused to the Government and shall decide whether the recovery should be made by a permanent reduction in the amount of the pension or by monthly instalments for a limited period.

(b) In every case of recovery from pension care shall be taken to see that the amount of pension left is adequate for the pensioner’s maintenance, and the portion withheld should not ordinarily exceed one-third of the amount of the pension.
